earnings.title: Prologis Supplemental Information THIRD QUARTER 2026 Unaudited Prologis Park Berlin, Berlin, Germany
outlook: At September 30, 2026, the company owned or had investments in, on a wholly owned basis or through co-investment ventures, properties and development projects expected to total approximately 1.3 billion square feet (123 million square meters) in 20 countries.

items.heading: As a global company, we are subject to social, geopolitical and economic risks associated with conducting business in many countries and our results of operations and financial condition may be materially and adversely affected.
items.group: Risks Related to our Global Operations

items.heading: Compliance or failure to comply with regulatory requirements could result in substantial costs.
Disruptions in the global capital and credit markets may adversely affect our operating results and financial condition.
The depreciation in the value of the foreign currency in countries where we have a significant investment may adversely affect our results of operations and financial position.
Our hedging of foreign currency and interest rate risk may not effectively limit our exposure to these risks.
General economic conditions and other events or occurrences that affect areas in which our properties are geographically concentrated may impact financial results.
